completed_work_packages.title: Cross-Machine Portable Recovery DEK Backup, Transactional SQL Migrations & R2 Quiesced Online-Backup Storage Migration
highlights: Replaced implicit-committing sqlite3.executescript() with atomic BEGIN IMMEDIATE ... COMMIT / ROLLBACK SQL statement execution verified by rollback test.

BackupService wraps jarvis.memory.master_dek.v1 inside the Argon2id + AES-256-GCM archive and re-encrypts restored is_encrypted=1 memories onto a target machine's new DEK while replaying deletion_ledger tombstones (U-D02).

StorageService uses SQLite Online Backup API (snapshot_core/snapshot_knowledge) for live WAL DB migrations and never deletes source data; wired POST /v1/storage/migrate/propose + /apply with single-use GUI R2 approval while keeping direct unapproved POST /v1/storage/migrate blocked (503).

completed_work_packages.title: Fix Private LAN capabilities_json HTTP 500, RFC1918 Private-Host Guard, Registry GPU VRAM Discovery & DynamicResourceGovernor
highlights: Fixed DEF-35 / IR-18 schema mismatch so registering a Private LAN provider writes valid ProviderCapabilityFlags and GET /v1/providers returns 200 (zero 500 crash).
Blocked public internet hosts from registering as authorized_lan (strict RFC1918/ULA/loopback/.local host verification).
Added pure-domain DynamicResourceGovernor (idle VRAM unload TTL, battery saver/gaming throttling, unhealthy LLM auto-fallback to Direct Mode) exposed via GET /v1/system/governor.
Added read-only Windows Registry 64-bit HardwareInformation.qwMemorySize lookup for AMD/Intel GPUs (verified live on host: Intel UHD Graphics 128 MiB + NVIDIA RTX 3050 4096 MiB).

completed_work_packages.title: Imperative 0-setState OrbitalCore, Structured Unified Diff ApprovalDialog, Interaction-First HUD & WCAG 2.2 AA
highlights: Removed React setAngleDeg inside requestAnimationFrame in OrbitalCore.tsx; uses direct SVG DOM ref transforms with verified ZERO React re-renders per animation frame.
Added structured line-by-line unified diff renderer with non-color-only screen-reader prefixes and expiry role='alert' inside native <dialog> ApprovalDialog.
Added aria-label on progressbar, aria-pressed on toggle buttons, and polite status region in OnboardingWizard; collapsed raw engine internals into native <details> disclosure in Command Center.
Verified 5 core theme color pairings via WCAG 2.2 AA contrast checker (6.72:1 to 15.45:1, all PASS).
